---

Prose body. The three wrong closed-set values above (toc, number-sections,
df-print) each render exit 1 under `quarto render` 1.7.33; the rest render
exit 0 and must never be flagged: `citations-hover: true` (valid boolean),
`documentclass: myclass` (OPEN string.completions), `format: htlm` (intentionally
UNVALIDATED — its enum is injected after closedness), `title:` (free string).
